name: tapora-proto-kit
description: Studio-grade interactive HTML prototypes, from first sketch to handover: design from scratch with decision gates, extend or tweak an existing prototype without design drift, and a regression QA kit with rolling baselines. Skill instructions are written in Vietnamese.

interface.shortDescription: Design, evolve and QA interactive HTML prototypes.
interface.longDescription: Design a website or web app from scratch as an interactive HTML prototype with five decision gates (sketch-to-site), extend it with new features without design drift (evolve-site), make small edits without ceremony (tweak-site), and run one full regression check before handover (handover-check). Includes a headless-browser QA kit with rolling baselines. Skill instructions are written in Vietnamese.
defaultPrompt: Thiết kế website cho một quán cà phê, dùng sketch-to-site.
Thêm bộ lọc theo ngày vào trang đơn hàng của prototype.
Kiểm tổng prototype trước khi bàn giao.
